mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notifications (user_id, notification_key, type, title, message, target_url) SELECT recipients.user_id, CONCAT('membership-', recipients.membership_id, '-', recipients.stage, '-', recipients.audience), 'MEMBERSHIP_EXPIRY', CASE recipients.stage WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN '회원권이 만료되었습니다' WHEN 'D0' THEN '회원권이 오늘 만료됩니다' ELSE CONCAT('회원권 만료까지 ', recipients.remaining_days, '일 남았습니다') END, CASE WHEN recipients.audience = 'ADMIN' THEN CONCAT(recipients.member_name, ' 회원의 ', recipients.product_name, ' 만료일을 확인해 주세요.') ELSE CONCAT(recipients.product_name, '의 이용 종료일은 ', DATE_FORMAT(recipients.end_date, '%Y.%m.%d'), '입니다.') END, CASE WHEN recipients.audience = 'ADMIN' THEN CONCAT('/admin/members/', recipients.member_id) ELSE '/member/memberships' END FROM ( SELECT m.user_id, mm.id membership_id, m.id member_id, m.name member_name, mp.name product_name, mm.end_date, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE) remaining_days, CASE WHEN mm.end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN mm.end_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'D0' WHEN mm.end_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 'D3' ELSE 'D7' END stage, 'MEMBER' audience FROM member_memberships mm JOIN members m ON m.id = mm.member_id JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id WHERE mm.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED') AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY UNION ALL SELECT u.id, mm.id, m.id, m.name, mp.name, mm.end_date, DATEDIFF(mm.end_date, CURRENT_DATE), CASE WHEN mm.end_date < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN mm.end_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN 'D0' WHEN mm.end_date <= CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 3 DAY THEN 'D3' ELSE 'D7' END, 'ADMIN' FROM member_memberships mm JOIN members m ON m.id = mm.member_id JOIN membership_products mp ON mp.id = mm.product_id CROSS JOIN users u WHERE u.role = 'ADMIN' AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND mm.status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED') AND mm.end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 7 DAY ) recipients
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, message, target_url, read_at, created_at FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET read_at = COALESCE(read_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE notifications SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
